verses: Then I saw the souls of those whom serpents sting and ever devour their tongues.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by those, whose soul suffers so severe a punishment?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'These are the souls of those liars and irreverent or 'untruthful' speakers who, in the world, spoke much falsehood and lies and profanity.'
